original_test_intent: Configure a named UFM Telemetry view and prove its panel, parameter, threshold and record-time settings can be saved, displayed and edited without changing fabric topology.
original_method: Identify the approved UFM instance/account and target view; export or capture the current view; add one approved panel; set its name, metric, unit, threshold and record time; save and reopen; verify rendered values and persistence; exercise parameter deletion/re-addition and panel deletion only within the disposable test view; restore the approved prior state.
manual_activity: UFM owner identifies a disposable view and acceptable dashboard settings; operator visually confirms panel rendering where API/export evidence is insufficient.
required_inputs: UFM endpoint/version and authorized UI account
Panel and metric names with units
safety_requirements: Use a disposable or backed-up telemetry view
Do not touch NDT/subnet merger/topology controls
Stop on unexpected scope or inability to restore; no automatic retry
engineer_actions: Define acceptable rendered values and persistence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only the generic UFM access concept fits; its subnet-merge risk is unrelated and must not authorize topology actions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved UFM Telemetry UI/API solely for the named disposable view; export before state and capture saved/reopened state after each bounded edit.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Add/delete panel, add/delete parameter, threshold display and record-time edit are retained; unspecified values remain pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform an auditable before/edit/save/reopen/restore sequence on one disposable telemetry view with an explicit setting-to-evidence matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact instance and view identity, concrete measurement oracle, prestate export, persistence checks and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic UFM workflow or topology deployment does not prove dashboard setting persistence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Persistent UI changes can overwrite an operator dashboard; displayed telemetry cannot be judged correct without named metric units and expected value source.

project_override_considerations: Project owner must define UFM release-specific labels/API fields, permitted test view, metric sources, threshold semantics, record-time range and whether deletion must persist after page reload.
expected_evidence: Displayed metric values correlated to source

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek describes subnet-merge/topology-deploy risk that belongs to the preceding NDT case; the Master row and GPT V2 consistently describe telemetry-view configuration.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution remains gated by the UFM target, concrete telemetry oracle, authorized test view and reversible prestate.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row420 Wistron-L12 Cluster-00003-V002: approve UFM instance/version/account, disposable view name, panels/metrics/units, thresholds and record-time bounds, authoritative displayed-value/persistence oracle, current-view backup and exact rollback.

review_improvement: Separates dashboard configuration from fabric deployment and makes each persistent UI mutation traceable and reversible.
independent_technical_reasoning: A panel existing after Save is not enough: the same view must be reopened and its metric identity, units, threshold and time window must match the approved configuration. Because UI state is persistent and shared, an exported prestate and scoped restoration are required even though no fabric topology changes are intended.
